listing.name: Lords of the Realm II / Open Lords2
listing.summary: Run the upstream engine preview with your own Lords of the Realm II installation.
listing.download_block_reason: Open the publisher’s preview release and choose the Windows ZIP or Linux tar.gz for your computer.

steps.title: Locate your original game folder
steps.instruction: Keep your installed copy of Lords of the Realm II. The engine looks for L2_maps.dat and either Lords2.exe or L2.eng to recognize the folder, and then reads the required game assets. The publisher tests with GOG’s edition.

steps.title: Start the player for your computer
steps.instruction: On Windows x64, run l2-game.exe from the extracted ZIP. It can find your installed copy or open its folder picker. It needs the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime. On Linux x64, extract the tar.gz and run l2-game with the absolute path to your original game folder as one argument. Linux needs glibc 2.34 or later and libasound.so.2. The preview does not provide a Linux folder picker.

steps.title: Keep your save and preference files
steps.instruction: Back up the active saves folder with the game closed. It defaults to %APPDATA%/open-lords2/saves on Windows or $XDG_DATA_HOME/open-lords2/saves on Linux, usually ~/.local/share/open-lords2/saves. An explicit LORDS2_SAVES directory takes precedence. Keep prefs.ini and your saves together when replacing an extracted engine copy.

warnings: This is the upstream preview. If you use its multiplayer option, both players need the same engine build and their own original game files.
